top_signals.title: Burq bets on the last-mile decision layer as giants retreat
top_signals.summary:
As enterprise retailers add regional carriers, 3PLs and gig couriers, Burq is pitching one layer to route, monitor and redispatch every order before the delivery promise breaks.
